# Metadata structure

\

## Sampling Variables

[*Categorical*]{.underline}

-   **Site**
    -   n = 22
        -   FCP - Four Canyon Preserve; Oklahoma, 36.0235,-99.9439
-   **Grassland type**
    -   n = 4
    -   tallgrass, mixed grass, shortgrass, desert
-   **Grass host species**
    -   n = 5
        -   ANGE (*Andropogon gerardii* / Big bluestem)
        -   SCSC (*Schizachyrium scoparium* / Little bluestem)
        -   BOER (*Bouteloua eriopoda* / Black grama)
        -   BOGR (*B. gracilis* / Blue grama)
        -   BUDA (*B. dactyloides* / Buffalograss)
-   ~~**Latitudinal Bin**~~
    -   ~~n = 4~~
    -   ~~North, North Central, South Central, South~~
-   ~~**Longitudinal Gradient**:~~
    -   ~~n = 3~~
    -   ~~East, Middle, West~~

[*Continuous*]{.underline}

-   **Elevation** (in meters)
    -   ranges from -20 to 2,747 m
-   **Latitude**
    -   29.23005 to 41.12200° N
-   **Longitude**
    -   -108.28760 to -94.13184° W\
        \

## Climate Data

[*Continuous*]{.underline}

-   **ppt** = mean annual precipitation (determined over 3- and 30-year windows and 2015)
-   **GDD** = growing degree days (determined over 3- and 30-year windows and 2015)\
    \

## Edaphic Variables

[*Continuous: (min, max values)*]{.underline}

-   **pH**: (`r round(range(sd$pH),2)`)
-   **SOM** (via LoI): (`r round(range(sd$SOM),2)`)
-   **soil moisture**: (`r round(range(sd$soil_moisture),2)`%)
-   **phosphorous**: (`r round(range(sd$phos),3)`)
-   **ammonium**: (`r round(range(sd$ammonium),2)`)
-   **nitrate**: (`r round(range(sd$nitrate),2)`)\
    \

## Plant Traits

[*Continuous: (min, max values)*]{.underline}

-   **avg_SLA**: specific leaf area (`r round(range(sd$avg_SLA),1)`)

-   **avg_SRL**: specific root length (`r round(range(sd$avg_SRL),1)`)

    -   Large values of specific leaf area (SLA) and specific root length (SRL) reflect large plant investment in resource acquisition; small values indicate investment in plant tissue longevity

-   **herbivory_perc**: (`r round(range(sd$herbivory_perc),1)`%)

    -   average site level damage estimate for herbivory, averaged over all species and individuals at the site; could be used to indicate herbivory pressure at the site level

\

# Data Standardization/Transformations

\
All continuous data predictors (climate, edaphic, and plant trait) were mean standardized, i.e., scaled to mean = 0 and SD = 1.\
\

```{r, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
var_sample <- c("Site","Grass","Grassland","Latitude","Longitude","Elevation_m")

var_climate <- c("coll_GDD_m.std","ppt30yr_m.std","ppt3yr_m.std","ppt2015_m.std","GDD30yr_m.std","GDD3yr_m.std","GDD2015_m.std")

var_edaphic <- c("pH_m.std","SOM_m.std","soil_moisture_m.std","phos_m.std","ammonium_m.std","nitrate_m.std")

var_plant <- c("avg_SLA_m.std","avg_SRL_m.std","herbivory_perc_m.std")

var_all_numeric <- c("Latitude","Longitude","Elevation_m",var_edaphic,var_climate,var_plant)

var_all <- c(var_sample,var_edaphic,var_climate,var_plant)

## untransformed
var_climate_ut <- c("ppt3yr","GDD3yr")

var_edaphic_ut <- c("pH","SOM","soil_moisture","phos","ammonium")

var_plant_ut <- c("avg_SLA","avg_SRL","herbivory_perc")

var_all_numeric_ut <- c("Latitude","Longitude","Elevation_m",var_edaphic_ut,var_climate_ut,var_plant_ut)

var_all_ut <- c("Site","Grass","Grassland",var_all_numeric_ut)
```

## Collinearity {.tabset .tabset-pills}

I assessed multicollinearity and removed correlated predictors, retaining ammonium over nitrate and soil moisture over similar measurements. For climate, only retaining 3yr values.\

Viewing tables of variable-variable correlations by category. Tables have been filtered to pearson correlation values \> 0.9 or \<-0.9.\

```{r autocorrelation-table, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

sd_m.std<-subset(sd, select = c("sample_name",var_all))

# Calculate correlations
correlation_matrix <- cor(select_if(sd_m.std, is.numeric), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# Set diagonal elements of the correlation matrix to NA
diag(correlation_matrix) <- NA

# Print table showing correlation values and associated variables
print(correlation_matrix)
# library(tidyr)

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
correlation_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(correlation_matrix))

# Rename columns
colnames(correlation_long) <- c("Var1", "Var2","Correlation")

# Remove rows with NA values (self-comparisons)
correlation_long <- correlation_long[complete.cases(correlation_long), ]

# Sort correlation_long dataframe by decreasing correlation
correlation_long_sorted <- correlation_long %>%
  arrange(desc(Correlation))

# Print the sorted correlation dataframe
# print(correlation_long_sorted)


# Apply the categorize_variable function to create a new column 'Variable Category'
correlation_long_sort_cat1 <- correlation_long_sorted %>%
  mutate(`Var1 Cat` = case_when(
    Var1 %in% var_climate ~ "Climate",
    Var1 %in% var_edaphic ~ "Edaphic",
    Var1 %in% var_plant ~ "Plant Trait",
    Var1 %in% var_sample ~ "Sampling",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

# Apply the categorize_variable function to create a new column 'Var2 Cat'
correlation_long_sort_cat12 <- correlation_long_sort_cat1 %>%
  mutate(`Var2 Cat` = case_when(
    Var2 %in% var_climate ~ "Climate",
    Var2 %in% var_edaphic ~ "Edaphic",
    Var2 %in% var_plant ~ "Plant Trait",
    Var2 %in% var_sample ~ "Sampling",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

# Determine 'Variable Category' based on 'Var1 Cat' and 'Var2 Cat'
correlation_long_sort_cat123 <- correlation_long_sort_cat12 %>%
  mutate(`Variable Category` = if_else(`Var1 Cat` == `Var2 Cat`, `Var1 Cat`, "Mixed"))

# Move the 'Variable Category' column to the 1st position
# correlation_long_sort_cat <- correlation_long_sort_cat123 %>%
  # select(`Variable Category`, everything())

correlation_long_sort_cat <- cbind("Variable Category"=correlation_long_sort_cat123$`Variable Category`,
                                        correlation_long_sort_cat123[,1:5])

# Filter for correlations > 0.9 for each Variable Category
correlation_high_sampling <- correlation_long_sort_cat %>%
  filter(`Variable Category` == 'Sampling' & (Correlation > 0.9 | Correlation < -0.9))

correlation_high_climate <- correlation_long_sort_cat %>%
  filter(`Variable Category` == 'Climate' & (Correlation > 0.9 | Correlation < -0.9))

correlation_high_edaphic <- correlation_long_sort_cat %>%
  filter(`Variable Category` == 'Edaphic' & (Correlation > 0.9 | Correlation < -0.9))

correlation_high_plant <- correlation_long_sort_cat %>%
  filter(`Variable Category` == 'Plant Trait' & (Correlation > 0.9 | Correlation < -0.9))

correlation_high_mixed <- correlation_long_sort_cat %>%
  filter(`Variable Category` == 'Mixed' & (Correlation > 0.9 | Correlation < -0.9))


# Print the filtered dataframes
# print(correlation_high_sampling %>%
#   filter(row_number() %% 2 == 0))
# print(correlation_high_climate %>%
#   filter(row_number() %% 2 == 0))
# print(correlation_high_edaphic %>%
#   filter(row_number() %% 2 == 0))
# print(correlation_high_plant %>%
#   filter(row_number() %% 2 == 0))
# print(correlation_high_mixed %>%
#   filter(row_number() %% 2 == 0))
```

Retaining GDD3yr over GDD2015 (degree growing days) & similarly, ppt3yr (mean annual precipitation)\

### Edaphic {.unnumbered}

Retaining soil_moisture over GWC and percent soil moisture (complement). Retaining ammonium over nitrate because Rudgers2021 did. I am considering removing phos.

# Summary stats of variables {.tabset .tabset-pills}

For these variable summaries, I am showing *non-standardized*/raw data values.\

```{r, results='asis',eval=TRUE, cache=TRUE}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(corrplot)

# Define the list of explanatory variable names
#var_all <- c("var1", "var2", "var3")  # Add all variable names here

# Define the dataframe containing the data
sd1 <- sd

idx <- match(var_all_ut, names(sd1))
idx <- sort(c(idx))

sd2 <- sd1[,idx] 
sdN <- select_if(sd2, is.numeric)

# Loop through each explanatory variable
for (var in var_all_numeric_ut) {
  
  # Print the current variable being explored
  cat("## ", var, " {.unnumbered} \n\n")
  
  # Summary statistics
  summary_stats <- summary(sdN[[var]])
  cat("Summary Statistics: \n\n")
  print(summary_stats)
  cat("\n\n")
  summary(sdN[[var]])
  cat("\n\n")
  
  # Histogram
  hist_plot <- ggplot(sdN, aes(x = !!sym(var))) +
    geom_histogram(fill = "skyblue", color = "black", bins = 20) +
    labs(title = paste("Histogram of", var),
         x = var, y = "Frequency") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Save histogram plot
  hist_file <- paste0("/Users/L347123/Desktop/ksu-paired-amplicon-workflow/docs/figures/explanatory_variables/histogram_", var, ".png")
  ggsave(hist_file, hist_plot, width = 5, height = 3)
  
  # Print histogram plot
  cat("### ", "Histograms of ",var, " {.unnumbered .tabset} \n\n")
  cat(" \n")

    cat("#### ", "All Sites", " {.unnumbered} \n\n")

    # knitr::include_graphics(hist_file)
  cat("![](/Users/L347123/Desktop/ksu-paired-amplicon-workflow/docs/figures/explanatory_variables/histogram_",var,".png){width=50%}", sep = "")
  
  cat("\n\n")
  
cat("#### ", "By Site", " {.unnumbered} \n\n")
      
  hist_plot_bysite <- ggplot(sd, aes(!!sym(var), fill=Site)) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = 'fixed',ncol=6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = latlong_cols)+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = if (2 * IQR(sdN[[var]],na.rm = T) / (length(sdN[[var]])^(1/2)) < 0) function(x) 2 * IQR(x) / (length(x)^(1/2)) else 1
                 )+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = 'black', fill=NA, linewidth=.75),legend.position = 'none',strip.text = element_text(color='black', size=12),axis.text = element_text(color='black', size=10))

    # Save histogram plot
  hist_file_bysite <- paste0("/Users/L347123/Desktop/ksu-paired-amplicon-workflow/docs/figures/explanatory_variables/histogram_bysite_", var, ".png")
  ggsave(hist_file_bysite, hist_plot_bysite, width = 6, height = 4)

  cat("![](/Users/L347123/Desktop/ksu-paired-amplicon-workflow/docs/figures/explanatory_variables/histogram_bysite_",var,".png){width=90%}", sep = "")

  cat("\n\n")

cat("#### ", "By Grass", " {.unnumbered} \n\n")
      
  hist_plot_bygrass <- ggplot(sd, aes(!!sym(var), fill=Grass)) +
  facet_wrap(~Grass, scales = 'fixed',ncol=3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bac_grass_cols)+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = function(x) 2 * IQR(x) / (length(x)^(1/2)))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = 'black', fill=NA, linewidth=.75),legend.position = 'none',strip.text = element_text(color='black', size=12),axis.text = element_text(color='black', size=10))

    # Save histogram plot
  hist_file_bygrass <- paste0("/Users/L347123/Desktop/ksu-paired-amplicon-workflow/docs/figures/explanatory_variables/histogram_bygrass_", var, ".png")
  ggsave(hist_file_bygrass, hist_plot_bygrass, width = 6, height = 4)

  cat("![](/Users/L347123/Desktop/ksu-paired-amplicon-workflow/docs/figures/explanatory_variables/histogram_bygrass_",var,".png){width=60%}", sep = "")

  cat("\n\n")

  
  cat("#### ", "By Fun Clusters", " {.unnumbered} \n\n")
      
  hist_plot_byFun_sor_clusters <- ggplot(sd, aes(!!sym(var), fill=Fun_sor_clusters)) +
  facet_wrap(~Fun_sor_clusters, scales = 'fixed',ncol=5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_n10)+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = if (2 * IQR(sd[[var]],na.rm = T) / (length(sd[[var]])^(1/2)) < 0) function(x) 2 * IQR(x) / (length(x)^(1/2)) else 1
                 )+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = 'black', fill=NA, linewidth=.75),legend.position = 'none',strip.text = element_text(color='black', size=12),axis.text = element_text(color='black', size=10))

    # Save histogram plot

  ggsave(hist_file_byFun_sor_clusters, hist_plot_byFun_sor_clusters, width = 6, height = 4)

  cat("![](/Users/L347123/Desktop/ksu-paired-amplicon-workflow/docs/figures/explanatory_variables/histogram_byFun_sor_clusters_",var,".png){width=90%}", sep = "")

  cat("\n\n")
```

```{r perform-anova-for-taxa-function, include=FALSE,eval=F}
perform_anova_for_taxa <- function(phylo_obj, taxa_of_interest, ContinuousVar) {
    # Subset the sample data to include only the specified taxa_of_interest and the ContinuousVar
  subset_data <- subset(sample_data_df, select = c(ContinuousVar))

  # Perform ANOVA for the specified taxa_of_interest against the ContinuousVar
  anova_result <- aov(otu_df ~ subset_data[[ContinuousVar]])
  tidy_aov <- tidy(anova_result)
  tidy_df <- as.data.frame(tidy_aov)
  
  tidy_df$term[1] <- paste0(ContinuousVar)

  sum_squares_regression <- tidy_df$sumsq[1]
  sum_squares_residuals <- tidy_df$sumsq[2]

  R_squared <- sum_squares_regression /
            (sum_squares_regression + sum_squares_residuals)*100

  tidier_df <- data.frame(statistic = numeric(),
                          R_squared = numeric(),p.value = character(),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  #tidier_df[1,"predictor"] <- tidy_df$term[1]
  tidier_df[1,"statistic"] <- tidy_df$statistic[1]
  tidier_df[1,"R_squared"] <- R_squared
  tidier_df[1,"p.value"] <- tidy_df$p.value[1]

  # Return ANOVA results for the specified taxa_of_interest
  return(tidier_df)
}
```
